rationale: S-0069-04 proposes co-inserting Nav1.6 and Kv3 on the AIS at biologically informed densities. t0075 (bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep) covers this in two ways: (a) the literature-informed AIS baseline includes Nav1.6 at medium density and Kv3 at medium density together by default; (b) Stage 2 axes 5 and 6 sweep AIS Nav1.6 and AIS Kv3 densities respectively across {0, low, medium, high}, holding the other co-inserted channel at the baseline density. Together the baseline and the two axes characterise the joint Nav1.6 + Kv3 AIS configuration more thoroughly than the two-condition probe S-0069-04 originally proposed. Rejecting as covered.
